title: ChineseLearningBookPageOutput
description: Strict response schema for Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash structured generation of Chinese learning book pages.

pageType.description: The category of activity page being generated.

title.description: Page headline in Chinese, e.g. 晨光初照的太阳与云彩.

theme.description: Unit pedagogical theme, e.g. 自然天地.

targetCharacters.description: List of target Chinese characters taught on this page.

masterSvg.description: Complete, valid, standalone SVG document (viewBox 0 0 612 792, US Letter) meeting Simple Chunky specifications.

closedRegionsCount.description: Number of closed colorable regions (must be 25-45 for CBN).

colorPalette.description: Traditional color mapping used in the legend.

safetyMarginsCheck.description: True if drawing content stays within US Letter print-safe boundary (margin >= 36pt).

visualMetaphorExplanation.description: Pedagogical rationale explaining how the visual drawing anchors to the character glyph skeleton.
